sources.name: Missoula Underground

sources.name: The BoZone
sources.use: Local event leads. Confirm venue dates and avoid reusing old listings as current news.

sources.use: Gym and team connections across several Montana locations. A class page alone is not a news story.

sources.name: Montana MMA
sources.use: The old gym site links here. Current page could not be read during this check. Confirm dated team announcements manually.

sources.name: KillEagle Promotions

sources.name: Big Medicine MMA

sources.name: FightForce

sources.name: Tapology
sources.use: Cross check amateur and professional records, bout level and card changes. Verify important claims with an original source.
